SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Sign reading 7.2.2.Reading syllables (ra-ru, ta-tu) Fingerspelling syllables, part of Strand 7 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / PP2 General.

Key inquiry question: How do we sit when reading? 2. How do we turn pages of a book when reading?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Sign reading 7.2.2.Reading syllables (ra-ru, ta-tu) Fingerspelling syllables together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Self-efficacy as learner correctly reads the syllables in class.

● Communication and collaboration: observation and signing skills as learner observes and correctly signs the syllables.

Values:
● Responsibility: determination as learner engages in assigned roles of reading syllables.

● Respect: humility as learner patiently take turns in reading syllables.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Effective communication as learner signs syllables effectively in communication while interacting.
